concepts.definition: Glycopeptide antibiotic active against Gram-positive bacteria including MRSA.

value_json: History of cholestatic jaundice with azithromycin

interactions.mechanism_text: Azithromycin may potentiate warfarin anticoagulant effect, raising INR.
Loop diuretic potentiates aminoglycoside oto- and nephrotoxicity.
interactions.management_text: Avoid concurrent use where feasible; monitor hearing, renal function and hydration.

interactions.mechanism_text: Ciprofloxacin inhibits CYP1A2 and displaces warfarin, potentiating anticoagulant effect.
interactions.management_text: Monitor INR closely; anticipate warfarin dose reduction.

interactions.mechanism_text: Amoxicillin may alter gut flora that synthesize vitamin K, enhancing warfarin effect.
interactions.management_text: Monitor INR during and after the antibiotic course.

interactions.mechanism_text: Additive nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity from concurrent glycopeptide and aminoglycoside.
interactions.management_text: Avoid combination if possible; monitor renal function and drug levels; consider audiometry.
